default_source.description: Name of the group source used when a group expression carries no @source: prefix

confdir_paths.description: Directories scanned for additional *.conf group-source files; $CFGDIR expands to the package config dir

group_sources.description: Ordered list of group sources; each source is a named INI section with shell commands that resolve node groups

name.description: Source identifier, used as the prefix in @name:groupname expressions and as the INI section header

map_cmd.description: Shell command that prints the node list (nodeset or one node per line) for the group named by $GROUP

list_cmd.description: Shell command that prints all group names available in this source, one per line

all_cmd.description: Shell command returning every node known to this source; leave empty to omit (enables @source:all expansion)

reverse_cmd.description: Shell command returning group names for the node named by $NODE; leave empty to omit (enables reverse lookups)

cache_time.description: Seconds to cache shell command output; 0 or empty disables caching
